before.title: Alhambra Mk2 Tailgate Gas Strut Failure
before.description: Like most heavy-tailgate vehicles, the 2010-2020 Alhambra Mk2 (and twin VW Sharan) tailgate gas struts gradually weaken with age — typically 4-6 years to the point where the heavy tailgate either fails to stay up or slowly closes on fingers. Generic age/UV/temperature wear rather than a SEAT-specific defect. The electric-tailgate variant requires the strut+motor module assembly together, which raises repair cost significantly.
before.solution: Manual-strut pair replacement €60-€120 in parts, 15-30 min DIY. Electric tailgate module €350-€600 per side. Use the manual override (button on inside of tailgate) if a strut fails suddenly — don't rely on the remaining one.
